name: symposium-ml
description: Remote ML training monitor for the Symposium rig — live loss curves, VRAM/GPU telemetry, rig logs, and one-key 'start a training run on the rig'.

commands.title: Symposium: Start Training Run on Rig

symposium.rig.url.markdownDescription: Base HTTP(S) URL of the Symposium training service (the `trainer/` FastAPI server, e.g. `uvicorn trainer.server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8765`). The extension derives the run endpoint (`POST <url>/runs`) and the live metric stream (`ws(s)://…/runs/latest/metrics`) from this. Point it at your gaming rig's LAN address to monitor training remotely.

symposium.rig.token.markdownDescription: Optional bearer token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on rig HTTP requests and WebSocket handshakes. Leave empty for an open LAN rig.

symposium.rig.autoConnect.markdownDescription: Automatically connect the **Symposium Rig** log channel to the rig's live run stream when the extension activates.
